children: Scilex received a Nasdaq notice on November 24 for failing to timely file its Q3 2026 Form 10-Q. It has until January 25, 2027, to submit a compliance plan and intends to file as soon as possible.
Nasdaq cited late Q3 2026 Form 10-Q filing
The filing delinquency creates listing-compliance risk and leaves investors without the quarter's financial report.
If Scilex has not filed by then, it says it will submit a plan; Nasdaq acceptance is not assured.
Nasdaq may grant up to 180 calendar days from the report's due date, subject to accepting the plan.

This is a compliance setback tied to a specific overdue quarterly report, not a new operating or financial update. The next catalyst is the Q3 Form 10-Q filing or Nasdaq's response to a compliance plan by January 25, 2027.
from Scilex Holding Company distributed by GlobeNewswire.
